creativity.title: Creativity
creativity.help: The higher you go, the more decisions the AI makes — and the more credits the generation uses.

low.label: Low
low.description: Proven layouts, adapted to your brand guidelines and their art direction. The AI writes the copy.

medium.label: Medium
medium.description: The AI also picks the structure (sections, scenes, slides) among validated options. The safest at the usual price.

high.label: High
high.description: The AI composes each part — layouts, transitions, sequencing — among options filtered by your art direction.

max.label: Max
max.description: The AI also tunes the details — emphasis, colours, rhythm, density — within bounds that keep everything legible.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.description: The AI creates everything: layouts, compositions, animations. Your brand guidelines and best practices stay guaranteed; any part that fails the checks is redone at Max.
